description:
About Snorkel 

 Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes. 

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

 About the Role 

 We're looking for talented and versatile Product Engineers to join our team. In this role, you'll build end-to-end products — from front-end interfaces through the APIs and services that power them — that make sophisticated workflows simple for our users. You'll work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to translate complex requirements into elegant, high-quality experiences, moving fluidly across the stack to get the job done.

 We are looking for talented Engineers who bring strong technical depth in React and TypeScript (and are comfortable working further down the stack when needed), a sharp product sense, and a passion for building software that makes sophisticated workflows feel intuitive.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Build, ship, and maintain high-quality product features with full ownership from design through production, working across the front end and, as needed, the services that support it

 Enable operations teams to move fast by building the right abstractions and tools that provide safe use of agent workflows

 Collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers to define and implement solutions that push the product forward

 Contribute to architecture decisions across the stack — advocating for scalability, maintainability, and clean code principles

 Drive best practices for accessibility, responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility within your team

 Design and build APIs and services where a feature calls for it, ensuring a clean contract between front end and back end

 Participate in and contribute to code reviews, raising the quality bar across the codebase

 Proactively identify technical challenges and propose solutions to improve the product engineering ecosystem

 Troubleshoot and resolve performance and production issues across the stack

 Work a hybrid schedule with at least three days per week in San Francisco, CA office or in our New York City office.

 
 What We're Looking For 

 We are hiring for Product Engineers at several levels, but the core experience is below:

 
 4+ years of professional experience in software engineering, with strong depth in React and TypeScript and solid full-stack or front-end fundamentals

 Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern CSS frameworks (e.g., Tailwind)

 Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, React Context API)

 Comfort designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and enough back-end fluency (Node.js, Python, or similar) to build or extend a service when a feature requires it

 Experience with responsive design, adaptive design, and accessibility standards (WCAG)

 Proven track record delivering high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code in a product environment

 Strong communication skills — able to articulate technical decisions clearly to cross-functional partners

 Ability to prototype and iterate quickly on sophisticated user workflows

 Comfortable working independently and making scoped technical decisions

 Experience collaborating in an agile, cross-functional team environment

 
 Nice to Have 

 
 Experience with design systems and building reusable component libraries

 Familiarity with server-side rendering frameworks (e.g., Next.js)

 Experience with performance optimization for web applications

 Prior work in developer tools or data-heavy product environments

 Experience owning a feature across the full stack, from database or service layer through UI

 
 Why This Role 

 You'll have meaningful ownership over a product used by technical and enterprise teams solving real, high-stakes problems. This isn't a feature-factory role — you'll be working on interfaces and the systems behind them to make genuinely complex workflows feel simple, with a team that cares deeply about craft.

  

 Snorkel AI is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Snorkel AI embraces diversity and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. 
 Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

 Salary range(s) for this role
 $220,000 — $300,000 USD 


 Be Your Best at Snorkel 

 Joining Snorkel AI means becoming part of a company that has market proven solutions, robust funding, and is scaling rapidly—offering a unique combination of stability and the excitement of high growth. As a member of our team, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to shape priorities and initiatives, influence key strategic decisions, and directly impact our ongoing success. Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical expertise, explore leadership opportunities, or learn new skills across multiple functions, you’re fully supported in building your career in an environment designed for growth, learning, and shared success.

 Snorkel AI is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Snorkel AI embraces diversity and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Snorkel AI prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, performance, merit, and business need. 

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
